title.narrative: Restoring Education System Performance and Improving Resilience Project

description.narrative: The development objective of Restoring Education System Performance and Improving Resilience Project for Burkina Faso are to: (i) expand access to pre-primary and primary education in selected areas; (ii) improve learning in supported schools; and (iii) strengthen education services. This project has three components. The first component, Expanding access to safe, modern and resilient education infrastructure, has the following sub-components: New construction; and Rehabilitation. The second component, Supporting education in emergencies and ensuring inclusion, has the following sub-components: Supporting education emergency responses; Supporting return to schooling; Facilitating accessibility to education for vulnerable children; and Narrowing gender disparities at the primary level. The third component, Improving foundational learning, has the following sub-components: Ensuring students access to high quality learning materials; Strengthening in-service teacher professional development; and Implementing a student management and monitoring module. The fourth component, Strengthening Institutional Capacity, has the following sub-components: Strengthening data collection platforms and the link between evaluations and policy reforms; and Strengthening institutional capacity and efficiency in project management.
